відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"version\":\"1\",\"text\":\"The brown heeled dress shoes, the beige trench and the beige bag stay in warm, quiet tones, so the terracotta trousers get all the attention. The pearly necklace brings a soft shine up near your face, which suits a church morning. This look takes you through the service and on to lunch with your parents: it is neat enough for church and relaxed enough for the table. It also lets you stand out the way you want. The terracotta is a confident, warm colour, and the cream sweater and beige layers around it are close enough in tone to look deliberate. The tied belt of the trench marks your waist and gives the wide trousers a clear anchor. The trousers then fall in one long, straight line to the heel of your shoes, so the eye travels down your legs.\",\"how_to_wear\":[\"Tie the belt of the trench in a knot at the front and leave the buckle as a detail. This marks your waist and balances the width of the terracotta trousers.\",\"Keep the collar of the trench down. A knotted belt is already one casual gesture, and a raised collar on top of it would make the look seem untidy.\",\"Wear the trench open over the cream sweater so the terracotta trousers stay the boldest colour and the lighter pieces frame it.\"],\"wrong_photos\":[],\"named\":[{\"n\":\"#196·41\",\"what\":\"beige double-breasted trench coat\"},{\"n\":\"#540·41\",\"what\":\"terracotta wide trousers\"},{\"n\":\"#189·34\",\"what\":\"cream sweater\"},{\"n\":\"#46·35\",\"what\":\"brown heeled dress shoes\"},{\"n\":\"#187·07\",\"what\":\"beige bag\"},{\"n\":\"#341·35\",\"what\":\"pearly necklace\"}],\"about_items\":[{\"n\":\"#189·34\",\"text\":\"A soft cream sweater that gives the outfit a light, warm base next to your face.\"},{\"n\":\"#540·41\",\"text\":\"Wide-cut trousers in a rich terracotta. They fall in a long, flowing line and are the colour statement of the outfit.\"},{\"n\":\"#196·41\",\"text\":\"A double-breasted trench coat in warm beige with a regular cut and its own belt that ties at the waist. It gives a polished, structured outer layer.\"},{\"n\":\"#46·35\",\"text\":\"Brown dress shoes with a heel. They are smart and grounded, and the heel adds a little length to the leg line.\"},{\"n\":\"#187·07\",\"text\":\"A simple bag in soft sandy beige. Its calm colour is easy to wear with everything else.\"},{\"n\":\"#341·35\",\"text\":\"A necklace in a pearly, creamy tone with a gentle shine. It adds a quiet, elegant glow at the neckline.\"}]}"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":7583,"output_tokens":2126},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
